newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-OLAZABAL CAN SEAL RYDER PLACE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OLAZABAL CAN SEAL RYDER PLACE.

text.p: Spain's Jose Maria Olazabal can virtually seal his Ryder Cup place at the English Open this week if he continues his remarkable form since returning from an 18-month injury layoff.
European captain Severiano Ballesteros predicted back in February -- even before Olazabal had hit a ball on his return -- that his compatriot would make the team automatically.
And Olazabal has more than fulfilled the captain's prediction, winning once and finishing with nothing worse than 12th in his six counting events since returning.

Including his two American events, with a share of 12th place in the Masters, Olazabal is an amazing 73-under-par for 28 rounds of golf and failed to win a second title two weeks ago only when he was edged out at the Italian Open by German Bernhard Langer.
Langer, who added the Benson and Hedges International title on Sunday and who is taking this week off, has secured his Valderrama place for the biennual clash with the Americans.
It could be Olazabal's turn this weekend at the new venue for the English Open, Hanbury Manor, northeast of London.
Olazabal took last week off in line with his schedule of two weeks on and then a rest, visiting the doctor in Munich who has restored him to fitness after his chronic foot problems.
His absence last week caused him to drop a place on the Ryder Cup table to 11th and he will look to move back up again this week. A win would leave his place in the team a formality.
European Ryder Cup table leader Colin Montgomerie will be anxious to put behind him last weekend's inglorious 76, 81 finish, while Australian Robert Allenby defends the title.
Allenby had to fend off Montgomerie last year and the Scot was runner-up the year before after losing a playoff.

Hanbury Manor is a new course which incorporates some of the holes from an original nine-hole layout designed by legendary English professional Harry Vardon, winner of the British Open a record six times.
